records.title: GPTCoach: Towards LLM-Based Physical Activity Coaching
records.reason: GPTCoach is an LLM-based health-coaching chatbot evaluated in formative interviews and a small lab study; it concerns user interaction and personalization, not limited-memory LLM inference/offload. The linked LLM-in-a-Flash relation is not technically supported.

records.title: DoraemonGPT: Toward Understanding Dynamic Scenes with Large Language Models
records.reason: DoraemonGPT builds symbolic video memory and tool-planning for visual agent tasks, evaluated on agent benchmarks; it does not improve prompt compression or inference systems efficiency. Its Gist Tokens link is not a substantive method connection.
